external_topology: Explicit and inferred boundaries retained separately
n_linked_sequon_definition: N-X-S/T, X is a standard amino acid other than proline
sequon_conservation: All three residues map contiguously to an extracellular sequon
disulfide_pair_conservation: Both annotated cysteine endpoints correspond and the counterpart annotation subtype matches
single_disulfide_endpoint: Reported separately; counterpart bond connectivity unresolved
annotation_counting: Feature records rather than unique experimentally verified sites
missing_annotation: Not evidence of absence of the biological modification
limitations: Glycan occupancy and glycan structures not determined
Extracellular topology does not establish luminal accessibility
